about: D2: is an issue specified enough for the implement lane to produce code without asking questions
ask: The state is a software issue (`title`, `body`) that an autonomous coding agent would implement without asking any questions. Does `body` say what to change, where (files, modules, or components), and how to check it is done (acceptance criteria, a test, or a command), with no open design decision left to the implementer? Answer yes only when all three are present and nothing is left to decide. Answer no for maps, epics, alerts, questions, discussion, reports, or anything that needs a human decision first.

no.why: missing what, where, or done, or a decision is open

fields.title: the config loader: reject a value outside the allowed range
fields.body:
## Defect

`src/config/load.ts` accepts a negative interval and then loops without waiting.

## Ask

Validate the interval at load time: an integer from 1 to 3600 seconds. Anything else is a config error naming the key and the value.

## Done means

- A test with `-5` fails with the named error.
- A test with `60` loads unchanged.

## Non-goals

No change to the default value.
